title: Physical AC1021 RASTERVARIABLES writer and DXF output bridge
scope: A locally available AC1021 producer sample is read, its single direct-NOD RASTERVARIABLES callback and modeled common links are checked, then those captured values seed a locally authored dependency-closed AC1021 wrapper DWG. The wrapper is re-imported, exported to ASCII and Binary DXF with invalid-state atomic refusal and same-adapter retry, and read back as a typed rooted graph. This demonstrates a bounded physical-input-to-writer bridge; it does not export the physical drawing or qualify native raster behavior.

physicalWitness.limitations: The physical import remains partial: 40 unrelated object parse failures, 44 AC1021 CRC mismatches, and 40 failed source frames.

projection.kind: locally authored AC1021 DWG wrapper generated inside the focused selector
projection.admission: The selector requires empty EED/XDATA, no data-storage payload, XDictionary-missing flag 1, and the single NOD soft-pointer reactor observed in the physical sample.
checks: invalid class-version refusal with destination preservation
invalid reactor refusal with destination preservation
out-of-range units refusal with destination preservation
output qualification bound to wrapper source frame
projection.fixturePolicy: The wrapper DWG and output DXFs are generated in temporary storage and removed after the selector; no DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.

validation.result: 9/9 focused generated transport tests passed across AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 routes
passed; source census plus local wrapper DWG re-import, ASCII/Binary refusal/retry and typed readback

nonClaims: The physical drawing itself is not eligible for whole-source DXF output; its import is partial.
The generated wrapper is a bounded control, not an original-source byte-preserving conversion.
No native AutoCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or independent raster-display/unit semantic acceptance was run.
This does not establish broader producer/version support or close P4.
